messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT 1958765432 — partial auth failures (eu-west-1). Some hosted API requests to /v1/* are returning 401/503. Impact: ~10% of requests from a subset of customers. Status page: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/1958765432 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ajensen: Investigating. Telemetry shows spikes in latency to auth-redis and a bunch of connection timeouts from auth-proxy -> redis replicas. Seeing error class: redis timeout (ETIMEDOUT) around 1958765400 UTC.
maria-g: Confirmed. Auth-proxy pods in eu-west-1 hitting connection pool exhaustion and retry storms. Increasing pool + starting rolling restart for proxy.
devon: Applying fallback token-cache layer to proxies (TEMP) — this will let cached tokens bypass redis checks. Patch applied to 3/6 nodes, monitoring.
samir: Logs — sample 503 response from proxy: ```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "auth_backend_unavailable",
  "code": 503
}
```
patrick: Noted customer reports about 401s from SDKs. Please confirm which endpoints are affected (auth vs token refresh).
ajensen: Affected calls are token-introspection and token-refresh endpoints. Short-lived access tokens validated fine when cached. Non-cached refresh flows hit the backend.
maria-g: Rolling restart complete for first 3 pods, errors dropped from ~10% -> ~3% in the last 4m. Continuing restarts.
devon: Quick mitigation applied: `export REDWOOD_AUTH_FALLBACK_TTL=30s` to allow 30s local caching of validated tokens. Should reduce load on redis during failover.
ops-bot: Update: we've enabled fallback cache globally in eu-west, and started rerouting auth traffic to read-primary in another AZ. Observed errors down to 0.7% over last 5m. Customers with Dedicated and Private unaffected.
samir: We're still seeing a degraded replica come up and rejoin, which caused a short spike during failover window. Root cause candidate: Redis replica promotion lag + network flaps.
ajensen: Current status: mitigation in place, traffic stabilized. We're keeping proxies on increased pool sizes for 2h. Active follow-ups: (1) Postmortem, (2) Alert tuning for redis replica latency, (3) Add proxy-level circuit breaker to avoid retry storms.
maria-g: Posting incident summary to #incidents-updates and creating internal postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1958765432. If you were paged, please add notes. :memo:
patrick: Thanks team. Can ops-bot push a short customer-facing blurb to status page noting root cause and that services are back to normal?
ops-bot: Done — status page updated with a "mitigated" state and note about Redis replica failover and temporary token-cache fallback. Link again: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/1958765432 :white_check_mark:
ajensen: Closing note: Monitoring will continue. We'll send final postmortem eta ~24h. Reaction: :thumbsup:
